cathouse.description: catherd in VS Code: Claude plans and verifies while Codex, opencode or Claude Code workers write the code, starting on the cheapest model that can do each job. CatHouse replaces catherd's terminal setup and TUI with one-click setup, a chat to start tasks, and live views of every role, budget and milestone.
cathouse.untrusted: CatHouse runs catherd and coding agents in your repository, so it needs a trusted workspace.
